printers.name: FlashForge Creator 5 Pro
printers.notes: 4-tool toolchanger driven by the ff_toolchange Klipper extra (github: creator5-custom-firmware). It registers the toolchanger and tool T0..T3 objects itself; per-tool Z is managed by TOOL_Z_ADJUST and the print-start offset by TOOLCHANGE_SET_PRINT_OFFSET, so HelixScreen's probe-based Z-offset flow does not apply. Distinguished from the non-Pro only by the chamber heater: the two machines are otherwise the same hardware, and the stock firmwareExe builds differ in nothing else.

heuristics.reason: Chamber heating element -- only the Pro has one

printers.name: FlashForge Creator 5
printers.notes: The plain Creator 5: same 4-tool toolchanger as the Pro, but no chamber heating element. Its printer.chamber.cfg declares [temperature_sensor chamber] where the Pro declares [heater_generic chamber_heater], so the chamber temperature still reads and nothing can command heat. The two entries are identical apart from that one heuristic, which is what separates them.

heuristics.reason: Chamber thermistor with no heater -- the non-Pro build
